{{scope|{{w|Grian (YouTuber)|Wikipedia}}}} {{Infobox person |image=Grian IRL.jpg |imagesize=300px |date_of_birth= |years active=2015–present |twitter=GrianMC |youtube=Grian |youtubecode=Grian |nationality=British |languages=English |minecraft roles= * Documentarian * Gamer * Mapmaker * Panelist |signature=[[File:Grian_sig.svg|150px|class=skin-invert-image]] |twitch=Grian}} '''Grian''' is an English [[YouTube]]r known for his participation on the [[Hermitcraft]] [[server]]. == In the ''Minecraft'' franchise == To promote the release of {{MCE}}, a series of videos starring [[Mumbo]] and Grian were produced.{{YouTube link|YtBQtOYsuT8|I got to play MINECRAFT EARTH (early)|Grian|July 15, 2019}} To assist with the production, a special [[Mumbo Jumbo & Grian Skins|skin pack]] was given to them; the game lacked the ability to import [[Skin|skins]] directly. In 2019, to celebrate the culmination of one trillion views on Minecraft content, Grian made a cameo appearance in [[Minecraft Celebrates the Community! (Yes, that means you!)|two]] [[One Trillion Minecraft Views on YouTube and Counting|separate]] [[cinematics]]. In 2022, he collaborated with [[Mojang Studios]] to recreate {{Wikipedia|Corfe Castle}} to celebrate [[Ancient City|ancient cities]].{{YouTube link|NtG44DA8HZM|A Historical Minecraft Build Challenge - ft Grian!|Minecraft|July 29, 2022}}{{YouTube link|NFvRfeZB5JY|Using Real Ruins to Create a Castle in Minecraft|Grian|July 30, 2022}} The following year, he was given early access to {{MCL}}.{{YouTube link|5WYDx3XnJ64|I got to play Minecraft Legends EARLY|Grian|April 6, 2023}} The following year, the world from Season 8 was also released.{{Mcnet|summer-sale-2025|Summer Sale 2025|July 1, 2025|Julius Olofsson}} For the [[15 Days of Minecraft]], an event was held in {{w|Alexandra Palace}}, {{w|London}} where a large cube was placed and could be decorated using magnets.{{tweet|xboxuk|1791771482353229858|The celebrations have started at Alexandra Palace 🥳 Join us TODAY for @Minecraft's 15th Anniversary and #ShapeYourWorld 🌍 🧱 An interactive 15th Anniversary Celebration 🕘 FREE and open to ALL until 9pm @yourallypally 💻 Can't make it? Stay tuned to our socials to get involved|May 18, 2024}} Grian helped with the process, appearing in a video.{{YouTube link|QSyLhUJ95G8|A MASSIVE build for our 15th Anniversary (ft. Grian)|Minecraft|June 4, 2024}} In 2025, he released a video promoting [[Spring to Life]].{{YouTube link|KqbGvYryBb0|#AD Let's recap the 1.21.5 Spring drop features!|Grian|April 8, 2025}} === Events === In 2016, Grian appeared at a panel for [[MINECON 2016|MINECON]].{{YouTube link|SlpeQtLASLs|MINECON 2016 Making Creative Minecraft Videos|Minecraft|October 20, 2016}} In 2024, he participated in the [[Ender Cup]], under the team Lime Llamas, alongside [[Daniel Middleton]]. In 2025, he was invited to try out [[Happy Ghast|happy ghasts]] for [[Minecraft LIVE – March 2025|Minecraft LIVE]].{{YouTube link|vso1iMwDuDk|I Flew to Sweden to Check Out the Happy Ghast|Grian|April 2, 2025}}{{Cite Instagram|minecraft|DHeztrRpChm|You wont believe what we're revealing at #MinecraftLIVE Make sure to tune in tomorrow!|March 22, 2025}} Later in the year, he and several other members of Hermitcraft would host the [[Hermitcraft Charity Event For Gamers Outreach 2025]] within the Mojang Studios headquarters. Later that year, he would participate in [[The Copper Crown]] edition of [[MC Championship]], under the team Pink Parrots. In 2026, he participated in [[Project G.L.O.P.]] under the team Green Geckos, and is set to participate in [[Fall Stars]] under the team Pink Parrots. == Trivia == * In 2015, Grian volunteered for the [[Java Realms Content Creator Program]], releasing a map known as TNT Run.{{Tweet|Marc_IRL|639427402041532416|Teaser for a new (old) upcoming Realms map.
Also, Memory Battle and TNT Run are fixed and available to play again!}} This went on to become a very popular minigame, used on servers such as {{Wikipedia|Hypixel}}.{{YouTube link|CYBgbKDioT0|TNT RUN! (Minecraft Mini Game) w/ Craftedmovie|Samgladiator|May 27, 2013}}{{YouTube link|4okw8z2uHKA|Minecraft: Mini Game: TNT Run!|Gizzy Gazza Cartoons|May 22, 2013}}{{Reddit|gg6oa6|3=Grian created TNT Run...|4=Needleflight|5=May 9, 2020}} * In 2017, Grian was invited over to Mojang's headquarters.{{YouTube link|efJQnefdqT0|Grian Goes To Sweden (I was invited to Minecraft HQ)|Grian|October 5, 2017}} * A tutorial of his for large scale builds was showcased in an article on [[Minecraft.net]].{{Mcnet|how-do-mega-builds|How to do MEGA builds|October 19, 2021|Kate Gray}} Another article linked a "classic" from him about a haunted house build.{{Mcnet|october-2020-community-roundup|Community Roundup: October|October 29, 2020|Nova Barlow}}{{YouTube link|pt6_Zql2LpE|How to make a HAUNTED HOUSE in Minecraft!|Grian|October 27, 2017}} == Gallery == === Renders === File:Grian.png|Grian's skin === Screenshots === File:Grian on Rooted Together map.png|Grian in [[Rooted Together]] File:Grian playing Rooted Together map.png|Grian playing [[Rooted Together (map)|Rooted Together]] File:Dried Ghast Stage 2 Grian.jpg|Grian's image of a [[dried ghast]], playing as [[Makena]] File:Dried Ghast Stage 3 Grian.jpg|Another image from the same session === Photographs === File:Grian summit 1.jpg|alt= File:Grian summit 2.jpg|alt= File:Grian summit 3.jpg|alt= File:Grian summit 4.jpg|alt= File:Grian's print.jpg|A print sent to Grian File:Grian and Mumbo's llama.jpg|Grian and Mumbo before a {{MCE|jolly llama}} File:BigB and Grian.jpg|Grian and [[BigB]] == References == {{reflist}} == Navigation == {{Navbox community}} {{Navbox event|Participants}} [[Category:MINECON]] [[Category:Minecraft Live]] [[Category:MC Championship]] [[Category:Realms]] [[Category:YouTubers]] [[zh:Grian]]
